inclusion: Insomnia diagnosed according to formal diagnostic criteria (e.g. DSM, ICD, ICSD) or judged by scores above a clinical threshold on an insomnia questionnaire
Eligibility criteria of the trial include daytime impairment
Patients with psychiatric or physical comorbidities, with or without sleep medication

Cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia (CBT-I), regarded broadly as any psychotherapy involving at least one of the following components: sleep hygiene education, cognitive restructuring, third wave components, constructive worry, sleep restriction, stimulus control, paradoxical intention, sleep diary, relaxation
Any delivery format (individual, group, in-person, remote, self-help with or without guidance) and any duration
Pharmacological or psychological co-administration, if there were no systematic differences between study arms
exclusion: CBT-I that clearly includes active components focusing on other symptoms (e.g. depression, anxiety, pain), when such components are not equally distributed among study arms
Arms not described by the CBT-I components, e.g. active drug, pill placebo, exercise, yoga, acupuncture, bright light therapy with equipment

inclusion: Waiting list (including no treatment or attention/psychological placebo while on the waiting list)
Attention/psychological placebo control (including watchful waiting termed 'treatment as usual')
Psychoeducation or sleep hygiene education alone
exclusion: Another form of CBT-I (head-to-head comparisons are not part of this database)

inclusion: Insomnia severity at post-treatment and at long-term follow-up (longest follow-up between 3 and 12 months); scale prioritized ISI > SCI > FOSQ > ESS > PSQI > AIS > other self-reported scales > WASO/SOL > WASO > SOL
Remission as defined by the authors, at post-treatment and long-term follow-up
Sleep diary parameters (subjective, not polysomnography or actigraphy): sleep efficiency, total sleep time, sleep onset latency, wake after sleep onset
Cluster randomized trials (intra-cluster correlation assumed to be 0.05 if not reported)

exclusion: Results published only on trial registries
